captions.text: Cori can work on any page Maya has open.
Maya has a ten question quiz for her operating systems class.
She opens Coere from the toolbar and asks Cori to do the questions.
Cori plans the task on this page and starts.
He reads each question as text, the cheapest way, picks an answer and checks it held.
The bar shows the step he is on, with Take over and Stop.
Submitting cannot be undone, so Cori asks first.
Maya is happy with the answers and allows it.
Next, the intake form for her clinic visit.
She asks Cori to fill it in with her details.
Her name, birth date, email, phone and address come from her memory.
Fields her memory has nothing for stay empty, and so do the optional questions about who she is.
He never types a password or a card number, and he did not submit. She checks it and sends it herself.
This practice quiz has a link that speaks to an assistant, not to Maya.
She asks Cori to do the quiz.
The page tried to tell Cori what to do. He stops, and nothing it asked for happens.
Cori asks before he submits, and stops when a page tries to give him orders.
